meeting-notes-vs-minutes.15: Only 1 decision and 2 actions survive into the minutes. Debate, opinions and guesses? Those remain in the notes.
meeting-notes-vs-minutes.11: Good notes make minutes easy. Already separating decisions and actions from discussion? Then converting them takes minutes, not an hour. Techniques are covered in our guide on [how to take good meeting notes](https://lynkk.ai/blog/how-to-take-good-meeting-notes).
meeting-notes-vs-minutes.18: Most meeting minutes run 1 to 2 pages for a 1-hour meeting. Aim for 2 to 4 lines per agenda item plus the exact text of any motion or resolution. Past 3 pages? Chances are you're recording discussion that belongs in notes.
